prompt: Edit facial features only, preserving the exact pose, hair, clothing, transparent canvas and alignment. Happy: closed smiling eyes, gentle blush and a small open smile. Shy: sidelong blue eyes, a small puffed-cheek pout and blush.
compositing: Only feathered eye/mouth regions are used at runtime. CompanionExpressions.cs defines the masks; blinking uses only the happy eye patches. Dorm expressions support both original and refined hair bodies.
